newsitem.title: INDIA: INSTANT VIEW - India Reliance meets for bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - India Reliance meets for bonus issue.

text.p: India's top petrochemicals firm Reliance Industries Ltd said on Thursday its board would meet on June 26 to consider a bonus issue of shares.

The announcement reversed a mid-session fall in Bombay stocks. By 1510 hours, (0945 GMT) the Bombay index was up 17.74 points, or 0.43 percent, at 4,100.24, trading below its 52-week high of 4,148.86 set earlier this week.
Following are the comments from the market after the bonus meet announcement by Reliance.
SANJAY VAID, CHIEF DEALER AT LLOYDS SECURITIES
"It's been a while since these rumours had been floating and people had sort of given up. The news has definitely changed the market sentiment."
R RAMAKRISHNAN, CHIEF DEALER AT ASK-RAYMOND JAMES SECURITIES INDIA LTD

Much had been expected from Reliance. Now, finally everything had been put in black and white. The market is now eagerly awaiting the bonus ratio. The bonus announcement has reversed market mood, today.
VIDYUT DEVENDRA KUMAR, MEMBER-BROKER OF THE BOMBAY STOCK EXCHANGE

"The bonus meet announcement has led to renewed buying and given a boost to bull operators. The company may announce a cash bonus in the form of extra dividend which will help the firm in keeping its equity at current levels.
ASHITH KAMPANI, HEAD OF DEALING AT JM SHARE & STOCK BROKERS
"The bonus had been awaited and hopes had been built up since a pretty long time. The market is expecting a bonus of about 40-66 percent. A liberal bonus issue will change the market scenario.
